map.为什么中英文混排对不齐？: Why does mixed Chinese and English not align?
map.中文按字宽、英文单词按整体宽度，两端对齐需在中文字间插空格、英文保持词完整，混排: Chinese is measured per character and English per whole word; justification must insert spaces between Chinese characters while keeping English words intact, and the two logics differ when mixed, so some tools only distribute spaces evenly between characters.
